# Prepsaret

> Comprehensive online test prep platform offering certification and entrance exam courses across HR, project management, IT, teaching, and high school education.

Prepsaret provides extensive practice questions, study materials, and exam preparation courses for professional certifications (SHRM, HRCI, PMP, CompTIA) and educational exams (GED, HiSET, Praxis). The platform serves career professionals, educators, and high school students seeking certification and credential advancement.

## Key Topics

- SHRM-CP
- SHRM-SCP
- PMP
- PHR
- SPHR
- GPHR
- CompTIA A+
- GED
- HiSET
- Praxis
- practice questions
- exam preparation
- certification prep
- online learning
- study materials

## HR Certification Prep

- [SHRM-CP and SHRM-SCP Exam Questions](https://prepsaret.com/shrm-cp-and-shrm-scp): SHRM-CP and SHRM-SCP practice questions with real exam content
- [SHRM-CP Exam Practice Questions](https://prepsaret.com/courses/shrm-cp-test-prep): SHRM-CP prep with 700+ practice questions and study guide
- [SHRM-SCP Exam Practice Questions](https://prepsaret.com/courses/shrm-scp-test-prep): SHRM-SCP senior-level HR certification with 1500+ practice questions
- [HRCI - Practice Exam](https://prepsaret.com/hrci-practice-test): HRCI certification prep for PHR, SPHR, aPHR exams
- [PHR Exam Practice Questions](https://prepsaret.com/courses/phr-practice-test): PHR certification with 1500+ practice questions for HR professionals
- [SPHR Exam Practice Questions](https://prepsaret.com/courses/sphr-practice-test): SPHR Senior Professional in Human Resources practice test prep
- [aPHR Prep](https://prepsaret.com/courses/aphr-prep): aPHR associate HR certification prep with study guide and questions
- [SPHRi Prep](https://prepsaret.com/courses/sphri-prep): SPHRi international HR certification study guide and practice test
- [PHRi Prep](https://prepsaret.com/courses/phri-prep): PHRi international HR certification prep with practice questions
- [GPHR Prep](https://prepsaret.com/courses/gphr-practice-test): GPHR global HR certification practice test and study materials
